purpose: Exhaust every rule-proved retained soccer exact-score, first-to-score, full-game total, BTTS, and draw implication before spending another venue request.

retained_source.capture_role: immutable retained public Gamma response; side-specific prices are rejection-only
retained_source.bounded_population: every complete base-plus-suffix soccer event family present in the retained 100-event page

relation_contracts.package: NO explicit exact score plus YES implied home draw or away result
relation_contracts.cancellation: exact score resolves 0-0 while full-game result resolves draw

relation_contracts.package: NO neither-first-to-score plus YES full-game draw
relation_contracts.cancellation: first-to-score resolves Neither while full-game result resolves draw

relation_contracts.package: Over lower half-goal threshold plus Under higher half-goal threshold

relation_contracts.cancellation: total resolves 50-50 while full-game result resolves draw

price_contract.missing_side_specific_field: retain the relation but block escalation
price_contract.outcomePrices_role: not used because midpoint-like values cannot authorize a book

stopping_rules.one_or_more_strict_candidates: freeze only one current exact book batch for the deterministic best row
